expr: At the end of the day…

body: **Foco:** Mixed Conditionals — introdução — introdução.
**Phrasal verbs:** get by.
**Expressões:** At the end of the day….
**Pronúncia:** Acento para enfatizar informação.
**20 palavras novas** (economia básica).
**Texto do dia:** receita e instruções.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo usar condicionais mistos (If I had studied, I would be… / If I were rich, I would have…) numa receita e dizer get by e At the end of the day….

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: How to Cook on a Tight Budget
paras: If you **had planned** your meals last week, you **would be saving** money now. If you **were** more organized, you **would have bought** only what you need. When money is short, **get by** with simple ingredients: rice, beans and eggs.
**At the end of the day…** a good cook can **get by** with little.

items.q: If you had planned meals, you would be saving now.
A good cook can get by with little.

blocks.body: **Mistos** misturam tempos: condição **do passado** com resultado **do presente** (ou o contrário).

items.s: If you had planned, you ___ be saving now. (would)
If you were organized, you would ___ bought less. (have)
At the end of the ___ , it works. (day)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **At the end of the day…** — No fim das contas…
**Tighten your belt.** — Apertar o cinto.
**Make do.** — Virar-se com o que tem.
**Live frugally.** — Viver com economia.
**A penny saved is a penny earned.** — Um centavo poupado é um centavo ganho.
**How do I get by?** — Como me viro?
**If I had planned my meals, I would be saving money.** — Se eu tivesse planejado as refeições, estaria economizando.
**If you were organized, you would have bought less.** — Se fosse organizada, teria comprado menos.
**For better or worse.** — Para o bem ou para o mal.

rows: We get by. — Nós nos viramos.

blocks.task: Write 5 steps for cooking on a budget with mixed conditionals.
blocks.model: 1. If you had planned your meals, you would be saving money now. 2. If you were more organized, you would have bought only what you need. 3. Use simple ingredients: rice, beans, eggs. 4. Learn to get by with little. 5. At the end of the day, cooking at home is cheaper.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
